about: Lumbridge NPCs. Tiles are the OSRS Wiki's location maps (checked 2026-10-21), which give the tile but not which of a name's types stands there: cows take cow, cow2 and cow3 (ids 2790, 2791, 2793) in turn and calves cow2_calf and cow3_calf (2792, 2794), guessed. Every wander range is guessed (5) until recorded. The castle's NPCs, Hans among them, are in lumbridge-castle.json.
